profile.title: Dumbbell hypertrofieprogramma
profile.description: 10-weekse Jeff Nippard-geinspireerde cyclus voor 2x20 kg verstelbare dumbbells, pull-up bar en optionele arms/weak-point dag.

rules.name: Progressie
rules.description: Eerst reps toevoegen tot bovenkant range; daarna load verhogen als vorm/RPE klopt.

rules.name: Failure
rules.description: Early sets meestal 0-1 RIR; last set vaak RPE 10, behalve RDL/lunges/split squats.

rules.name: Dumbbell cap
rules.description: Als load niet omhoog kan: hogere reps, 2-4 sec eccentric, pauses, partials, myo-reps.

rules.name: Optionele dag D
rules.description: Vergroot hypertrofie als schouders/armen/chest/back herstellen en A/B/C niet dalen.

rules.name: Hardlopen
rules.description: Niet geoptimaliseerd voor marathonprestatie; benen blijven hypertrofie-gericht maar upper-body krijgt prioriteit.

muscle_targets.interpretation: Doen als A/B/C performance stabiel blijft

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
exercises.cues: Use overhand or neutral grip. Slow 2-3 sec negative, chest up, full stretch at bottom.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx B71:P71, B107:P107; Handbook PDF p. 15

exercises.name: Deficit Push-Up With Backpack
exercises.technique: Pec stretch hold after last set
exercises.cues: Use dumbbells as handles if stable. Go deep for pec stretch; add backpack before adding unstable tricks.
exercises.source: PPL xlsx B596; Full Body xlsx O59/O389; Handbook PDF p. 6, p. 14

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.source_exercise: Smith Machine Lunge / DB Step-Up / Reverse Lunge pattern
exercises.cues: Keep torso controlled. Stop 0-1 RIR only if balance and form stay tight.
exercises.source: PPL xlsx B104:P104, O222; Handbook PDF p. 6

exercises.name: 1-Arm DB Row - Elbow-In
exercises.source_exercise: Elbows-In 1-Arm DB Row / Arm-Out Single-Arm DB Row
exercises.cues: Let the lat stretch at the bottom. Pull elbow toward hip, not straight up.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx L31; PPL xlsx O207; Handbook PDF p. 15

exercises.name: DB Lateral Raise
exercises.source_exercise: DB Lateral Raise / Cuffed Behind-The-Back Lateral Raise substitute
exercises.cues: Strict first, then controlled partials only after full reps are done.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx O68, C104; PPL xlsx O66; Handbook PDF p. 16

exercises.name: Hammer Curl - Bottom 3/4
exercises.cues: Stay mostly in the bottom 3/4. No swing; squeeze handle hard.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx B67:P67, B420; Handbook PDF p. 12

exercises.name: DB Skull Crusher
exercises.source_exercise: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension -> DB Skull Crusher
exercises.cues: Let elbows travel slightly back for stretch; lock in upper arm angle.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx O69/O105; PPL xlsx O228; Handbook PDF p. 6

exercises.name: Seated DB Shoulder Press
exercises.cues: Seated on floor or stable chair. Keep reps smooth, no lower-back layback.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx B64:P64, B100:P100; PPL xlsx B620:P620

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.cues: Supinated grip biases biceps too. Add load only while full stretch and chin-over-bar stay clean.
exercises.source: PPL xlsx O91; Full Body xlsx O80; Handbook PDF p. 15

exercises.name: Paused DB RDL
exercises.cues: Do not chase failure here. Hips back, deep hamstring stretch, stop short of lockout.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx N65:P65, N101:P101; Handbook PDF p. 10

exercises.name: DB Floor Press
exercises.source_exercise: Low Incline DB Press / DB Chest Press substitute
exercises.cues: Replacement for bench press. Pause softly when triceps touch floor; keep pec tension.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx O59, L41; PPL xlsx B593; Handbook PDF p. 43

exercises.name: DB Pullover
exercises.cues: Keep ribs down. Stop where shoulder feels safe; think lats, not triceps.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx F30; PPL xlsx O63; Handbook PDF p. 14

exercises.name: Bent-Over Reverse DB Flye
exercises.cues: Start strict bent-over; as fatigue hits, stand slightly more upright while keeping rear delts loaded.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx O62/O82; PPL xlsx O93; Handbook PDF p. 14

exercises.name: Supinating DB Curl
exercises.source_exercise: DB Incline Curl / Bayesian Cable Curl substitute
exercises.cues: Start each rep with arm slightly behind torso if possible. Match weaker side.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx N85/O85; PPL xlsx N80; Handbook PDF p. 15

exercises.name: Seated DB French Press
exercises.cues: Both hands under one dumbbell head. Avoid resting at lockout.
exercises.source: PPL xlsx B81:P81, B199:P199

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
exercises.cues: If +10 kg gets easy, keep +10 kg and progress with pauses/partials/higher reps.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx O80, B116:P116; Handbook PDF p. 15

exercises.name: Feet-Elevated Push-Up
exercises.cues: Use bed for feet if stable. Alternate full reps with bottom-half reps when technique calls for it.
exercises.source: PPL xlsx B596; PPL xlsx B186:P186; Handbook PDF p. 15

exercises.name: DB Reverse Lunge
exercises.source_exercise: Smith Machine Reverse Lunge / DB Step-Up substitute
exercises.cues: Front leg does the work. Use long stride for glute, shorter for quad.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx B410; PPL xlsx B222:P222

exercises.name: 1-Arm DB Row - Arm-Out
exercises.source_exercise: Arm-Out Single-Arm DB Row / Super-ROM Cable Row substitute
exercises.cues: Elbow about 45 degrees out. Squeeze shoulder blade, stretch hard at bottom.
exercises.source: PPL xlsx O207; Full Body xlsx B66:P66

exercises.name: DB Lateral Raise - Myo
exercises.cues: Last set: hit failure, rest 5 sec, then 3-4 reps until fewer than 3 reps remain.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx C104/O104; Handbook PDF p. 16

exercises.name: Inverse DB Zottman Curl
exercises.cues: Hammer curl up, rotate palms up at top, lower palms-up under control.
exercises.source: PPL xlsx B92:P92, B210:P210

exercises.name: DB Triceps Kickback
exercises.cues: Shoulder slightly behind torso in the squeeze; smooth reps, no swing.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx O88/O124; PPL xlsx O230

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.source_exercise: Hanging Leg Raise / Roman Chair Leg Raise
exercises.cues: Round lower back as legs rise. Add reps before adding load.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx N76/O112; PPL xlsx B84:P84

exercises.name: DB Lateral Raise - Extended Set
exercises.source_exercise: DB Lateral Raise / Weak point shoulders
exercises.cues: Optional day earns its place by adding delt/arm stimulus with low systemic fatigue.
exercises.source: Handbook PDF p. 23; Full Body xlsx E25:F28

exercises.name: Bent-Over Reverse DB Flye - Extended Set
exercises.cues: Rear delts recover well and support shoulder width/upper back look.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx O82; PPL xlsx O211

exercises.name: Bottom-2/3 DB Curl
exercises.cues: Keep tension where dumbbells are hardest. No top rest.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx B87:P87, B123:P123

exercises.name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
exercises.cues: Brachialis/brachioradialis focus. Match weaker arm.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx B420; PPL xlsx O92

exercises.name: Close-Grip Push-Up
exercises.source_exercise: Close-Grip Assisted Dip / Triceps Pressdown substitute
exercises.cues: Use backpack only if elbows feel perfect. Stop when lockout quality fades.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx O86/O122; Handbook PDF p. 16

exercises.name: Deficit Push-Up Pump
exercises.cues: Keep this only if chest pressing performance is not dropping.
exercises.source: PPL xlsx B596; Handbook PDF p. 44

exercises.name: Weighted Chin-Up
exercises.cues: Supinated grip shifts more work to biceps while still hammering lats.
exercises.source: PPL xlsx O91; Full Body xlsx O80

exercises.name: Connected-Bar Floor Press
exercises.source_exercise: Low Incline DB Press / DB Chest Press substitute

exercises.source: Full Body xlsx O59; PPL xlsx B593

exercises.name: Front-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
exercises.source_exercise: Sissy Squat / DB Step-Up quad substitution
exercises.cues: Small elevation is enough. Knee forward, torso controlled.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx O74; PPL xlsx B224:P224

exercises.name: 1-Arm DB Row - Lat Stretch
exercises.source_exercise: Lat-Focused Cable Row / Elbows-In 1-Arm DB Row
exercises.cues: Use a slightly arcing row toward the hip. Long stretch matters more than load.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx B240:P240; Full Body xlsx L30

exercises.cues: Use a smooth arc and only the ROM your shoulder likes.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx B407:P407; PPL xlsx B625:P625

exercises.name: Slow-Eccentric DB Curl
exercises.cues: Use tempo as overload when jumps are too large.
exercises.source: PPL xlsx O92; Handbook PDF p. 6, p. 12

exercises.name: Slow-Eccentric DB Skull Crusher

exercises.source: Full Body xlsx B417; PPL xlsx O228

exercises.name: Standing DB Arnold Press

exercises.source: Full Body xlsx L27/O64; Handbook PDF p. 23

exercises.name: Lean-Back Pull-Up
exercises.source_exercise: Lean-Back Lat Pulldown / Medium-Grip Pull Up

exercises.source: PPL xlsx B91:P91, O91

exercises.name: Slow-Eccentric DB RDL
exercises.cues: Still not a failure lift. Keep it heavy, clean and repeatable.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx B398:P398; Handbook PDF p. 10

exercises.name: Deficit Push-Up - Integrated Partials
exercises.source_exercise: Pec Deck integrated partials / Deficit Pushup

exercises.source: PPL xlsx B186:P186, B596; Handbook PDF p. 15

exercises.name: DB Pullover - Long Stretch
exercises.cues: Do not turn it into a triceps extension. Ribs down, lats stretched.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx F30; PPL xlsx O63

exercises.name: Rear Delt DB Flye - Integrated Partials

exercises.cues: Alternate full reps and bottom-half partials. Stay controlled.

exercises.name: DB Scott Curl On Chair

exercises.name: Mechanical Drop Push-Up

exercises.source: PPL xlsx B596; Handbook PDF p. 14

exercises.name: DB Reverse Lunge - Long Stride

exercises.source: Full Body xlsx B410:P410

exercises.name: DB Row + Kelso Shrug
exercises.cues: After row reps, add 4-6 scapular shrugs for mid-back/traps.
exercises.source: Full Body xlsx B395:P395; PPL xlsx B588:P588

exercises.name: Rear Delt Mechanical Dropset
exercises.source_exercise: Cable Reverse Flye mechanical dropset -> DB reverse flye

exercises.name: Lean-Away DB Lateral Raise
exercises.source_exercise: Cross-Body Cable Y-Raise / DB Lateral Raise
exercises.cues: Hold the goal/post if safe; otherwise normal lateral raise.
exercises.source: PPL xlsx B96:P96, O96

exercises.source_exercise: Single-arm Overhead Cable Triceps Extension / DB French Press
